_comment: The Turing Accords JRPG — forge settings. Bible: D:\Turing Accords Game (10_Art_Direction_and_Production.md §10.1b/10.8). 2026-11-09: the game is high-resolution painted art at 1920x1080 (tile 96, hero cell 144x216); checkpoint picks per job type below come from bake-off 1 (docs/BAKEOFF_1_VERDICT.md); style_prefix is PROVISIONAL until the style bake-off (style_v1) is judged.
style_prefix: digital painting, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, strong value contrast, painterly brushwork with crisp detail at the focal point, 16:9 scene, no text
negative: text, letters, watermark, signature, logo, blurry, deformed, extra limbs, extra fingers, low quality, photo-realistic skin pores
_note_checkpoints_by_job: scene_paint, repaint, icon and sleeve read checkpoints_by_job / loras_by_job for their own type (job fields win); the older job types still read `checkpoint`/`loras` per job. game_root / asset_root / provenance_dir are where `forge approve` may write — nowhere else.
